_what: Eight DERIVED layer weights (Brief 3 Task 2, sec 3.4-3.6). Weights sum to 1; precedence and formulas in derive_layer_weights docstring; nothing painted.

inputs.flow: RESERVED, not read (gravel uses deposition; wet_shore uses water.json levels + hydro footprints, not flow)

constants._snow_base_m: read from the recipe's Snow band floor, not a local constant
constants._shaded_aspect: DERIVED from the sun azimuth (the light's travel yaw; the shaded flank faces along it), never a map axis

wet_shore._what: damp shoreline ring of each placed lake (Brief 4 T4): adjacent to the lake footprint AND within wet_shore_band_m above the water level; NOT a global elevation band
wet_shore.footprints_from: hydro_derive.level_slice on the committed 4x analysis heightmap (the hydrology tool of record); positive control vs water.json area_ha
wet_shore.renders_as: folds into the shader remainder (meadow/grass) at blockout; a distinct shore surface is a material-pass item (R-LAYERS5)

declared_zero.dirt_path: no path mask exists; the town's streets are ACTORS, not a landscape layer

units_note: the brief's forest-floor threshold '0.3 crowns/m2' is read as 0.3 crown-area COVER (a canopy-cover figure); 0.3 trees/m2 is denser than any forest
